svg.title: Babul-da guides the inspectors towards three shops where a cinema once stood.
svg.desc: Babul-da walks his cycle van through a lane that widens and narrows around old structures. Vale, Riju and Cecil follow as he directs them by a cinema now divided into three unrelated shops.
